article.headline: Antwan Burnett, Chilaydrien Newton lead Grambling past Florida A&M 79-72
article.description: — Antwan Burnett had 18 points and Chilaydrien Newton scored 17 off the bench to lead Grambling to a 79-72 victory over Florida A&M on Monday night.
article.linkText: Antwan Burnett, Chilaydrien Newton lead Grambling past Florida A&M 79-72
article.story: GRAMBLING, La. -- — Antwan Burnett had 18 points and Chilaydrien Newton scored 17 off the bench to lead Grambling to a 79-72 victory over Florida A&M on Monday night. P.J. Eason added 12 points and seven rebounds for the Tigers (4-13, 1/3 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Reserve Makale Stevenson scored 11. Milton Matthews scored a career-high 27 to lead the Rattlers (3-11, 0-3). Sterling Young scored 17. -------- Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here.
